command: set -eu; cp -a /source/. /work/; cd /work; cargo build --locked --release -p circomspect; target/release/circomspect --version; set +e; target/release/circomspect /box/attest.circom -L /box/node_modules --level INFO --sarif-file /out/original.sarif > /out/original.log 2>&1; echo $? > /out/original.exit; target/release/circomspect /box/repair-v1/attest.circom -L /box/node_modules --level INFO --sarif-file /out/repair.sarif > /out/repair.log 2>&1; echo $? > /out/repair.exit
